headSubject: fix(pack-signing): the signing digest is line-ending-insensitive for every JSON file of the pack, so a Windows checkout cannot invalidate a signature; conformance pack re-signed
summary: Owner answered the 6 open items. (1) pack:signature: PackSigningDigest (canonical JSON of every pack *.json, signature removed), PackAddMain verifies LOCAL packs too (they were skipped), packSign Gradle task, conformance pack really signed (key outside repo). (2) pack:propertyScopes: pack scope with from goes in front of the root scope. (3,4) autoPanel.name/concept/aggregate and transactionHooks.onCommit/onValidate DELETED (budget 718->713). (5) capability.specializes: kernel StaticCapabilityBindingResolver + runtimehost RuntimePluginAdapterRegistry fall back to the built-in of the same type. (6) samples for allowSideBySide (conformance v2), renamedFrom, panelLayout.children, guidePage, customWidgetRef. Catalogue 740/740 complete; generate_dsl_capabilities.py --check now fails on any incomplete keyword. Verified: DSL, generator, runtimehost-core, kernel tests; validateModel 0 errors; 163/163 probes; 12/12 browser routines in ONE run; T1 fast gate. REG-357 and REG-359 closed DONE with guards. NOT run: run-all-gates, the beta release gate, CI on these commits.
nextStep: Watch CI on main for commits 7222529e and 61a0e3fa (the conformance lock digests and the pack signature are checked on a Linux checkout; the signing digest is line-ending-insensitive but pack.json raw bytes feed the lock, pinned LF by .gitattributes). Then decide whether to run the full local beta release gate (over 1 h; keep scripts/reports/out/docker-linux-parity-report.json from the CI run, valid until 2026-11-24T21:47Z, from being overwritten).
